paras: 08 Days Jaipur-Ajmer-Pushkar-Udaipur-Jodhpur & Jaisalmer Tour Package
Tour Code #DR054
Rs.17,199/- per person
Day 01 – Arrival in Jaipur

A harmony of royal heritage, busy bazaars and rich culture set against the backdrop of majestic forts and palaces. Upon your arrival at Jaipur Railway Station or Airport, our representative will warmly greet you and guide you to your hotel. After settling in, take some time to relax. In the evening, engage yourself in the modern attractions of the Pink City:
Statue Circle: Monumental pride in Pink City.
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium: Heavenly arts under modern dome.
Vidhan Sabha: Legislative grace in architectural glory.
Birla Mandir: Marble amidst the urban bustle.
Jawahar Kala Kendra: Cultural canvas of artistic expressions.
Enjoy a delightful Rajasthani dinner at a resort with folk dance music and cultural performances in a rural village setting.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaipur.
Day 02 – Jaipur Sightseeing
After a refreshing breakfast, commence on a journey through the historic Pink City to visit its iconic landmarks:
Hawa Mahal: Palace of winds, history's whispers.
City Palace: Royal beauty in architectural brilliance.
Jantar Mantar: Heavenly observance in ancient honesty.
Jal Mahal: Submerged calmness amid urban hustle.
Amer Fort: Fortress of bravery, historical magnificence.
Nahargarh Fort & Places: Mountain castle with beautiful views.
In the evening, witness the captivating Light & Sound show at Amer Fort, a spectacular display of Rajasthan's history and culture.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaipur.
Day 03 – Jaipur – Ajmer – Pushkar – Udaipur
After breakfast, depart for Udaipur via Ajmer and Pushkar, both renowned for their religious significance and cultural heritage:
Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chishti at Ajmer: Sanctuary of faith, spiritual comfort.
Lord Brahma Temple at Pushkar: Sacred heart of immortal devotion.
Continue your journey to Udaipur and check in at the hotel.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Udaipur.
Day 04 – Udaipur Sightseeing
Dive into Udaipur’s charming shimmering lakes, luxurious palaces, and romantic vistas, a city that whispers tales of Rajput bravery and timeless romance.
Explore the captivating Lake City with visits to its unavoidable attractions:
City Palace: Royal grace in architectural magnificence.
Pratap Smarak: Heroic tribute in royal honour.
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal: Cultural heritage alive through art.
Saheliyon ki Bari: Garden of beauty and peacefulness.
Jagdish Temple: Divine grace in sculpted marvel.
Bagore ki Haveli: Legacy of luxury and artistry.
Shilp Gram: Craftsmanship celebrating Rajasthan's essence.
Fateh Sagar Lake: Peaceful water mirrors Udaipur's charm.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Udaipur.
Day 05 – Udaipur to Jodhpur Sightseeing
The Blue City, where the indigo shades of history blend seamlessly with the impressive Mehrangarh Fort and the busy markets.
After breakfast, travel to Jodhpur and check in at the hotel. Freshen up and then explore the fascinating Blue City:
Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum: Royal history preserved in grace.
Jaswant Thada: Marble honouring Rajasthan's heritage.
Mehrangarh Fort: Rajput strength in towering walls.
Clock Tower & Markets: Heartbeat of Jodhpur's vibrant culture.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jodhpur.
Day 06 – Jodhpur to Jaisalmer
Jaisalmer, where the golden sands of the Thar Desert meet the towering fortresses and indistinguishably carved havelis, weaving tales of bravery.
After breakfast, drive to Jaisalmer and check in at the hotel. Refresh and then visit the charming Golden City:
War Museum: Honouring bravery through silent stories.
Gadisar Lake: Peaceful oasis in golden sands.
Vyas Chhatri: Architectural grace amid desert stillness.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Jaisalmer.
Day 07 – Jaisalmer Sightseeing & Desert Experience
After breakfast, explore the architectural marvels of Jaisalmer:
Jaisalmer Fort & Palaces: Golden guardian of desert glory.
Jain Temples: Ancient artistry in sandstone marvels.
Patwon ki Haveli: Exceptional craftsmanship in desert habitation.
Salim Singh ki Haveli: Architectural grace in desert shades.
Nathmal ki Haveli: Symphony of tricky desert sculptures.
Later, experience a unique overnight stay in tents at the dunes desert. Enjoy cultural programs, camel rides, a mesmerizing sunset, and a traditional dinner.
Overnight stay at Desert Camp.
Day 08 – Jaisalmer Departure
After breakfast at the desert camp, visit additional places of interest:
Lodhurva: Historic whisper tales.
Amar Sagar: Oasis of peacefulness amidst sands.
Kuldhara: Ghost town echoes with history.
Later, you will be dropped off at Jaisalmer Railway Station or Airport for your onward journey. (The Tour Ends)

Where the past meets the present in a vibrant textile of cultures and histories, echoing through its busy streets and monumental landmarks.
